title: DocumentationExportResult
description: What profile.exportDocumentation actually wrote. Reported back so the interface can name the files rather than saying 'done', and so a test can assert the set of paths written equals the set previewed.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root that was written into.

writtenPaths.description: Repository-relative paths of every file written, created and overwritten alike.

overwrittenPaths.description: The subset of writtenPaths that already existed. Called out separately because replacing a file the user wrote is a different act from adding one, even when both were previewed.
